32.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 13; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 1, p. 134; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 75, p. 296; Tuhaf al-Uqul, p. 383; Nur al-Thaqalayn

33.ar: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ قُلْ لا أَسْئَلُکُمْ عَلَیْهِ أَجْراً إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِی الْقُرْبی فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ هَذَا إِنَّمَا یُرِیدُ أَنْ یَرْفَعَ بِضَبْعِ ابْنِ عَمِّهِ قَالُوهَا حَسَداً وَ بُغْضاً لِأَهْلِ بَیْتِ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی أَمْ یَقُولُونَ افْتَری عَلَی اللهِ کَذِباً فَإِنْ یَشَإِ اللهُ یَخْتِمْ عَلی قَلْبِکَ وَ لَا تَعْتَدَّ هَذِهِ الْمَقَالَ وَ لَا یَشُقَّ عَلَیْکَ مَا قَالُوا قَبْلُ مِنْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ یَمْحُو الْباطِلَ وَ یُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِکَلِماتِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدُورِ فَشَقَّ ذَلِکَ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ حَزَنَ عَلَی مَا قَالُوا وَ عَلِمَ أَنَّ الْقَوْمَ غَیْرُ تَارِکِینَ الْحَسَدَ وَ الْبَغْضَاءَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَیَحْزُنُکَ الَّذِی یَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لا یُکَذِّبُونَکَ وَ لکِنَّ الظَّالِمِینَ بِآیاتِ اللهِ یَجْحَدُونَ.
33.en: When this verse was revealed: "Say: I do not ask of you any reward for it except love for my near kin" (Shura/23), some people said, "God did not reveal this; he only wants to elevate the status of his cousin." They said this out of envy and hatred toward the Household of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). Therefore, God Almighty revealed: "Or do they say, 'He has fabricated a lie against God'? If God willed, He could seal your heart" (Shura/24). [O Prophet!] Do not pay attention to these statements, and let not what they said before weigh heavily upon you. "Indeed, God blots out falsehood and establishes the truth by His words; He is All-Knowing of what is in the breasts" (Shura/24). This [the words of the hypocrites] weighed heavily upon the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), and he was saddened by what they said, knowing that the people would not abandon their envy and hatred. Consequently, this verse was revealed: "We know that it grieves you what they say; for indeed, they do not deny you, but the wrongdoers reject the signs of God."
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 366

33.ar: فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی فَإِنَّهُمْ لا یُکَذِّبُونَکَ قَالَ لَا یَسْتَطِیعُونَ إِبْطَالَ قَوْلِکَ.
33.fa: فَإِنَّهُمْ لا یُکَذِّبُونَکَ، نمی‌توانند سخن تو را باطل کنند.
33.en: Regarding the saying of the Almighty, "For they do not deny you," he said: They are unable to invalidate your speech.
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 366
33.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 202 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 18, p. 232 / Al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn / Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 1, p. 359

33.ar: بَلَی وَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ کَذَّبُوهُ أَشَدَّ التَّکْذِیبِ وَ لَکِنَّهَا مُخَفَّفَةٌ لا یُکَذِّبُونَکَ لَا یَأْتُونَ بِبَاطِلٍ یُکَذِّبُونَ بِهِ حَقَّکَ.
33.fa: بله، به خدا سوگند به شدّت او را تکذیب کردند ولکن آن [کلمه در این آیه] بدون تشدید است: لا یُکْذِبُونَکَ؛ [یعنی] باطلی را نمی‌آورند که به‌وسیله‌ی آن [دعوت] حقّ تو را تکذیب کنند.
33.en: Yes, by Allah, they indeed denied him with the utmost denial. However, it [the word in this verse] is without a shadda (lightened): "la yukdhibunaka" [they do not call you a liar]; [meaning] they do not bring forth a falsehood by which they would deny your truth.
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 366
33.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 200; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 202; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 18, p. 231; al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Ayyashi, Vol. 1, p. 359; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 89, p. 65; al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 195

33.ar: یَا حَفْصُ عَلَیْکَ بِالصَّبْرِ فِی جَمِیعِ أُمُورِکَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بَعَثَ مُحَمَّداً (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَأَمَرَهُ بِالصَّبْرِ وَ الرِّفْقِ فَصَبَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) حَتَّی نَالُوهُ بِالْعَظَائِمِ وَ رَمَوْهُ بِهَا فَضَاقَ صدْرُهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عَلَیْهِ وَ لَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّکَ یَضِیقُ صدْرُکَ بِما یَقُولُونَ فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّکَ وَ کُنْ مِنَ السَّاجِدِینَ ثُمَّ کَذَّبُوهُ وَ رَمَوْهُ فَحَزِنَ لِذَلِکَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَیَحْزُنُکَ الَّذِی یَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لا یُکَذِّبُونَکَ وَ لکِنَّ الظَّالِمِینَ بِآیاتِ اللهِ یَجْحَدُونَ* وَ لَقَدْ کُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِکَ فَصَبَرُوا عَلی ما کُذِّبُوا وَ أُوذُوا حَتَّی أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا فَأَلْزَمَ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) نَفْسَهُ الصَّبْرَ.
33.en: O Hafs, you must practice patience in all your affairs, for Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and commanded him to be patient and gentle. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) remained patient until they accused him of grave matters and slandered him with them, which caused his chest to tighten. Then Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed to him: "And We know that your chest tightens because of what they say. So glorify the praise of your Lord and be among those who prostrate" (15:97-98). Then they denied him and slandered him, and he became saddened by that. So Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed: "We know that it saddens you what they say; for indeed, they do not deny you, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject. And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over what they were denied and harmed until Our victory came to them" (6:33-34). Thus, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) committed himself to patience.
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 366
33.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 2, p. 88; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 15, p. 261; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 202; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Mishkat al-Anwar, p. 25; al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 196; in them: "qabaluhu bi-l-'izam" (they confronted him with grave matters) instead of "naluhu bi-l-'azayim"; al-Burhan

33.ar: فَذَکَرَ مِنْ فَضْلِ وَصِیِّهِ ذِکْراً فَوَقَعَ النِّفَاقُ فِی قُلُوبِهِمْ فَعَلِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ذَلِکَ وَ مَا یَقُولُونَ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ جَلَّ ذِکْرُهُ یا محمد (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ لَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّکَ یَضِیقُ صدْرُکَ بِما یَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لا یُکَذِّبُونَکَ وَ لکِنَّ الظَّالِمِینَ بِآیاتِ اللهِ یَجْحَدُونَ وَ لَکِنَّهُمْ یَجْحَدُونَ بِغَیْرِ حُجَّةٍ لَهُمْ.
33.en: [The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)] mentioned some of the virtues of his successor, and as a result, hypocrisy entered their hearts. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) knew this and what they were saying. So Allah, the Majestic in His Remembrance, said: "O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), 'We know indeed that your breast feels straitened at what they say. It is not you that they deny, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject' (15:97). And they reject them without having any proof for themselves."
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 368
33.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn/ al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 293/ al-Burhan; therein: "fa-dhakara min fadl... sadruka" is omitted.

34.ar: عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ قَالَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ (علیه السلام) وَ قَدْ قُلْتُ لَهُ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) إِنَّ النَّاسَ یَنْسُبُونَنَا إِلَی عَظَائِمِ الْأُمُورِ وَ قَدْ ضَاقَتْ بِذَلِکَ صدُورُنَا فَقَالَ (علیه السلام) یَا عَلْقَمَةُ إِنَّ رِضَا النَّاسِ لَا یُمْلَکُ وَ أَلْسِنَتَهُمْ لَا تُضْبَطُ وَ کَیْفَ تَسْلَمُونَ مِمَّا لَمْ یَسْلَمْ مِنْهُ أَنْبِیَاءُ اللَّهِ (علیهم السلام) وَ رُسُلُهُ وَ حُجَجُ اللَّهِ أَ لَمْ یَنْسُبُوا نَبِیَّنَا محمدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَی أَنَّهُ شَاعِرٌ مَجْنُون أَ لَمْ یَنْسُبُوهُ إِلَی الْکَذِبِ فِی قَوْلِهِ إِنَّهُ رَسُولٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَیْهِمْ حَتَّی أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَیْهِ وَ لَقَدْ کُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِکَ فَصَبَرُوا عَلی ما کُذِّبُوا وَ أُوذُوا حَتَّی أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ یَوْماً عُرِجَ بِیَ الْبَارِحَةَ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ فَقِیلَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا فَارَقَ فِرَاشَهُ طُولَ لَیْلَتِه.
34.fa: علقمه گوید: به امام صادق (علیه السلام) عرض کردم: «ای فرزند رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله)! مردم [گناهان و] امور بزرگی به ما نسبت می‌دهند و به خاطر آن سینه‌های ما تنگ شده است». امام (علیه السلام) فرمود: «ای علقمه! رضایت مردم به دست نمی‌آید و زبان‌هایشان نگهداشته نمی‌شود. شما چگونه سالم می‌مانید از آنچه پیامبران خدا و رسولانش و حجّت‌های الهی (علیهم السلام) از آن سالم نماندند... آیا به پیامبر ما محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله) نسبت ندادند که او شاعر و مجنون است... آیا در مورد این سخنش که او رسولی از طرف خداوند به‌سوی آن‌ها است او را دروغگو نشمردند تا اینکه خدای عزّوجلّ بر او نازل فرمود: وَ لَقَدْ کُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِکَ فَصَبَرُوا عَلی ما کُذِّبُوا وَ أُوذُوا حَتَّی أَتاهُمْ نَصْرُنا. روزی پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «دیشب مرا به آسمان بردند»؛ پس گفته شد: «به خدا سوگند در طول شب از رختخوابش جدا نشده است».
34.en: Alqamah narrated: I said to Al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), "O son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), people attribute grave matters to us, and our hearts have become constricted because of this." He (peace be upon him) replied, "O Alqamah, the pleasure of the people cannot be attained, and their tongues cannot be restrained. How can you remain safe from that which the Prophets of Allah, His Messengers, and the Proofs of Allah (peace be upon them) were not safe from? Did they not attribute to our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) that he was a poet and a madman? Did they not accuse him of lying when he said that he was a Messenger from Allah to them, until Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) revealed to him: 'And indeed, messengers were denied before you, but they were patient over the denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them'? And one day, he (the Prophet) said, 'I was taken up to the heavens last night,' and it was said, 'By Allah, he did not leave his bed throughout his night.'"
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 368
34.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 67, p. 2; Al-Amali by al-Saduq, p. 102; Al-Burhan (in which the phrases "O son of the Messenger of Allah... madman" and "And one day... night" are omitted); Nur al-Thaqalayn (in which the phrases "O son of the Messenger of Allah... our hearts" and "Did they not attribute... madman" and "And one day... night" are omitted).

34.ar: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ أَیَّتُهَا الْعِصَابَةُ النَّاجِیَةُ إِنْ أَتَمَّ اللَّهُ لَکُمْ مَا أَعْطَاکُمْ بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا یَتِمُّ الْأَمْرُ حَتَّی یَدْخُلَ عَلَیْکُمْ مِثْلُ الَّذِی دَخَلَ عَلَی الصَّالِحِینَ قَبْلَکُمْ وَ حَتَّی تُبْتَلَوْا فِی أَنْفُسِکُمْ وَ أَمْوَالِکُمْ وَ حَتَّی تَسْمَعُوا مِنْ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّهِ أَذًی کَثِیراً فَتَصْبِرُوا وَ تَعْرُکُوا بِجُنُوبِکُمْ وَ حَتَّی یَسْتَذِلُّوکُمْ وَ یُبْغِضُوکُمْ وَ حَتَّی یَحْمِلُوا عَلَیْکُمُ الضَّیْمَ فَتَحَمَّلُوهُ مِنْهُمْ تَلْتَمِسُونَ بِذَلِکَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ وَ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ وَ حَتَّی تَکْظِمُوا الْغَیْظَ الشَّدِیدَ فِی الْأَذَی فِی اللَّهِ جَلَّ وَ عَزَّ یَجْتَرِمُونَهُ إِلَیْکُمْ وَ حَتَّی یُکَذِّبُوکُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ یُعَادُوکُمْ فِیهِ وَ یُبْغِضُکُمْ عَلَیْهِ فَتَصْبِرُوا عَلَی ذَلِکَ مِنْهُمْ وَ مِصْدَاقُ ذَلِکَ کُلُّهُ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ الَّذِی أَنْزَلَهُ جَبْرَئِیلُ عَلَی نَبِیِّکُمْ سَمِعْتُمْ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِنَبِیِّکُمْ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَاصْبِرْ کَما صبَرَ أُولُوا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَ لا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَ إِنْ یُکَذِّبُوکَ فَقَدْ کُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِکَ فَصَبَرُوا عَلی ما کُذِّبُوا وَ أُوذُوا فَقَدْ کُذِّبَ نَبِیُّ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ الرُّسُلُ (علیهم السلام) مِنْ قَبْلِهِ وَ أُوذُوا مَعَ التَّکْذِیبِ بِالْحَقِّ.
34.en: O saved group! Fear God. If God completes for you that which He has bestowed upon you, He will not bring the matter to completion until there befalls you the like of that which befell the righteous before you; until you are tested in your selves and your wealth; until you hear much harm from the enemies of God and you remain patient and endure it; until they humiliate you and hate you; until they impose injustice upon you and you bear it from them, seeking thereby the Face of God and the Abode of the Hereafter; until you suppress intense rage regarding the harm that they commit against you for the sake of God, the Majestic and Exalted; and until they belie you regarding the truth, show you enmity for it, and hate you because of it, and you remain patient with them through all of that. The verification of all this is in the Book of God, which Gabriel brought down upon your Prophet. You have heard the word of God, the Mighty and Majestic, to your Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): "So be patient, as the messengers of determination were patient, and do not be in haste for them." Then He said: "And if they deny you, then messengers before you were already denied; so they were patient over what they were denied and [how they were] harmed." Indeed, the Prophet of God (peace be upon him and his family) and the messengers (peace be upon them) before him were denied and were harmed along with the denial of the truth.
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 368
34.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 75, p. 213; Nur al-Thaqalayn

35.ar: فِی قَوْلِهِ وَ إِنْ کانَ کَبُرَ عَلَیْکَ إِعْراضُهُمْ قَالَ کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) یُحِبُّ إِسْلَامَ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَامِرِبْنِ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ دَعَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ جَهَدَ بِهِ أَنْ یُسْلِمَ فَغَلَبَ عَلَیْهِ الشَّقَاءُ فَشَقَّ ذَلِکَ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی وَ إِنْ کانَ کَبُرَ عَلَیْکَ إِعْراضُهُمْ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ نَفَقاً فِی الْأَرْضِ یَقُولُ سَرَباً.
35.fa: وَ إِنْ کانَ کَبُرَ عَلَیْکَ إِعْراضُهُمْ، رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) دوست داشت حارث‌بن عامربن نوفل‌بن‌عبد مناف مسلمان شود. رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) او را دعوت کرد که مسلمان شود و او آن را انکار نمود و شقاوت بر او غالب شد و این امر بر رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) سخت شد و خدای متعال نازل فرمود: وَ إِنْ کانَ کَبُرَ عَلَیْکَ إِعْراضُهُمْ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَبْتَغِیَ نَفَقاً فِی الْأَرْضِ، یعنی نقب و سوراخی در زمین.
35.en: Regarding His saying: "And if their turning away is hard for you," he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) loved for al-Harith ibn 'Amir ibn Nawfal ibn 'Abd Manaf to become Muslim. The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) invited him and strove hard for him to accept Islam, but wretchedness overcame him. This was difficult for the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), so Allah the Exalted revealed: "And if their turning away is hard for you," up to His saying: "a tunnel in the earth," meaning a passage or a hole in the earth.
35.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 370
35.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 203; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 203; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan; Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 197

35.ar: فِی قَوْلِهِ نَفَقاً فِی الْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّماً فِی السَّماءِ قَالَ إِنْ قَدَرْتَ أَنْ تَحْفِرَ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ تَصَّعَّدَ السَّمَاءَ أَیْ لَا تَقْدِرُ عَلَی ذَلِکَ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَ لَوْ شاءَ اللهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَی الْهُدی أَیْ جَعَلَهُمْ کُلَّهُمْ مُؤْمِنِینَ وَ قَوْلُهُ فَلا تَکُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجاهِلِینَ مُخَاطَبَةٌ لِلنَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ الْمَعْنَی لِلنَّاس.
35.fa: نَفَقاً فِی الْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّماً فِی السَّماءِ، اگر بتوانی در زمین گودال بکنی یا به آسمان بالا روی؛ یعنی بر آن توانایی نداری. وَ لَوْ شاءَ اللهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَی الهُدی، یعنی همه‌ی آن‌ها را مؤمن قرار می‌دهد. و کلام خداوند: فَلا تَکُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجاهِلِینَ، [در ظاهر] خطاب به پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) است ولی مقصود خطاب به مردم است.
35.en: Regarding His saying: "a tunnel into the earth or a ladder into the sky," he said: If you were able to dig into the earth or ascend into the sky—meaning, you are not capable of that. Then he said: "And had Allah willed, He would have gathered them upon guidance," meaning, He would have made them all believers. And His saying: "So do not ever be among the ignorant," is an address to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), but the meaning is intended for the people.
35.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 370
35.refs: Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 198 / Al-Burhan; in it: "And His saying 'So do not ever be...' is for the people" is omitted.

35.ar: عَن عَلِیِّ بنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) أَنَّهُ قَالَ کُنْتُ أَمْشِی مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فِی بَعْضِ طُرُق فقَالَ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أ فَإِنَّکَ مِنِّی بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ (علیه السلام) مِنْ موسی (علیه السلام) وَ مَنِ اتَّبَعَهُ وَ هُمْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْعجلِ وَ مَنِ اتَّبَعَهُ یَا عَلِیُّ (علیه السلام) إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی قَدْ قَضَی الْفُرْقَةَ وَ الِاخْتِلَافَ عَلَی هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ وَ لَوْ شَاءَ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَی الْهُدی حَتَّی لَا یَخْتَلِفَ اثْنَانِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ وَ لَا یُنَازَعَ فِی شَیْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَ لَا یَجْحَدَ الْمَفْضُولُ ذَا الْفَضْلِ فَضْلَه.
35.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابی‌طالب (علیه السلام) نقل کرده است: در یکی از راه‌های مدینه همراه رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) می‌رفتم که فرمود: «تو نسبت به من مانند هارون نسبت به موسی (علیه السلام) و پیروان او هستی و آن‌ها (مخالفان تو) به‌منزله‌ی گوساله [سامری] و پیروانش هستند. ای علی (علیه السلام)! خدای تبارک‌وتعالی تفرقه و اختلاف را بر این امّت مقدّر نموده امّا اگر خدا بخواهد، آن‌ها را [به اجبار] بر هدایت جمع خواهد کرد تا جاییکه دو نفر از این امّت با هم اختلاف نداشته باشند و در چیزی از فرمان او نزاع نشود، و کسی که در فضل پایین‌تر است، برتری صاحب فضل را انکار نمی‌کند».
35.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated: I was walking with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) on one of the paths when he said: "You are to me in the position of Aaron (peace be upon him) to Moses (peace be upon him), and those who follow you are in that position, while they [your opponents] are in the position of the Calf and those who followed it. O Ali (peace be upon him)! Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, has decreed division and disagreement upon this Ummah. Had He willed, He would have gathered them upon guidance so that no two people from this Ummah would disagree, nor would they dispute anything of His command, and the one of lesser merit would not deny the merit of the one of greater merit."
35.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 370

35.ar: عَن أَمِیرِالمُؤمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) حَدِیثٌ طَوِیلٌ وَ فِیهِ یَقُولُ (علیه السلام) مُجِیباً لِبَعضِ الزَّنَادَقَةِ وَ قَد قَالَ: وَ أَجِدُهُ قَدْ بَیَّنَ فَضْلَ نَبِیِّهِ عَلَی سَائِرِ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (علیهم السلام) ثُمَّ خَاطَبَهُ فِی أَضْعَافِ مَا أَثْنَی عَلَیْهِ فِی الْکِتَابِ مِنَ الْإِزْرَاءِ عَلَیْهِ وَ انْتِقَاصِ مَحَلِّهِ وَ غَیْرِ ذَلِکَ مِنْ تَهْجِینِهِ وَ تَأْنِیبِهِ مَا لَمْ یُخَاطِبْ أَحَداً مِنَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (علیهم السلام) مِثْلُ قَوْلِهِ وَ لَوْ شاءَ اللهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَی الْهُدی فَلا تَکُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجاهِلِینَ وَ الَّذِی بَدَا فِی الْکِتَابِ مِنَ الْإِزْرَاءِ عَلَی النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مِنْ فِرْقَةِ الْمُلْحِدِینَ.
35.fa: حدیثی طولانی از امیرالمؤمنین (علیه السلام) است و در آن در جواب بعضی از زندیق‌ها که گفته بود: «می‌بینم که خدا [در قرآن] فضیلت پیامبرش را بر سایر انبیاء (علیهم السلام) بیان کرده؛ سپس او را چندین برابر آنچه در کتاب بر او ثنا گفته، مورد عتاب و خطاب قرار داده است که عبارت باشند از: عیب‌گرفتن بر او، و کم‌کردن جایگاه او و غیر آن، از سرزنش او و توبیخش به چیزی که هیچ‌یک از پیام-بران را مورد خطاب قرار نداده است؛ مانند کلام خداوند: وَ لَوْ شاءَ اللهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَی الهُدی فَلا تَکُونَنَّ مِنَ الْجاهِلِینَ. امام (علیه السلام) می‌فرماید: «سرزنش بر پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) که در کتاب خدا ظاهر شده [و آمده] است، از دروغ پردازی منحرفان [و منافقان] است».
35.en: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) in a long hadith, in which he responds to some of the heretics (zanadiqa) who had said: "I find that He [God] has clarified the excellence of His Prophet over all other prophets (peace be upon them), yet He has addressed him with several times more reproach, belittlement of his station, and other forms of disparagement and rebuke than the praise He bestowed upon him in the Book—addressing him in a way He did not address any other prophet (peace be upon them), such as His saying: 'And if Allah had willed, He would have gathered them upon guidance, so do not be among the ignorant' (6:35)." The Imam (peace be upon him) replied: "The reproach against the Prophet (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) that appears in the Book is [a fabrication] from the sect of the atheists (mulhidin)."
35.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 370

36.ar: إِنَّما یَسْتَجِیبُ الَّذِینَ یَسْمَعُونَ یَعْنِی یَعْقِلُونَ وَ یُصَدِّقُونَ وَ الْمَوْتی یَبْعَثُهُمُ اللهُ أَیْ یُصَدِّقُونَ بِأَنَّ الْمَوْتَی یَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّه.
36.fa: إِنَّما یَسْتَجِیبُ الَّذِینَ یَسْمَعُونَ یعنی می‌اندیشند و تصدیق می‌کنند. وَ الْمَوْتی یَبْعَثُهُمُ اللهُ، یعنی تصدیق می‌کنند که خداوند مردگان را [در قیامت] برمی‌انگیزد.
36.en: "Only those who hear respond," meaning they reflect and believe. "And the dead, Allah will resurrect them," meaning they believe that Allah will resurrect the dead [on the Day of Resurrection].
36.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 372
36.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 203 / al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 198

36.ar: فِی قَوْلِهِ إِنَّما یَسْتَجِیبُ الَّذِینَ یَسْمَعُونَ وَ الْمَوْتی یَبْعَثُهُمُ اللهُ ثُمَّ إِلَیْهِ یُرْجَعُونَ نَزَلَتْ فِی عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) لِأَنَّهُ أَوَّلُ مَنْ سَمِعَ وَ الْمَیِّتُ الْوَلِیدُبْنُ عُقْبَةَ.
36.fa: یَسْتَجِیبُ الَّذِینَ یَسْمَعُونَ وَ الْمَوْتی یَبْعَثُهُمُ اللهُ ثُمَّ إِلَیْهِ یُرْجَعُونَ، در مورد علی (علیه السلام) نازل شده؛ زیرا او اوّلین کسی است که [برای پذیرفتن دعوت پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله)] گوش شنوا داشت و [منظور از] «مرده» ولیدبن‌عقبه است.
36.en: Regarding the verse, "Only those who listen will respond, but as for the dead, Allah will raise them; then to Him they will be returned," it was revealed concerning Ali (peace be upon him), for he was the first to listen [to the Prophet's call], and the "dead" refers to Walid ibn Uqba.
36.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 372
36.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 38, p. 234; Al-Manaqib, Vol. 2, p. 9

37.ar: فِی قَوْلِهِ إِنَّ اللهَ قادِرٌ عَلی أَنْ یُنَزِّلَ آیَةً وَ سَیُرِیکُمْ فِی آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ آیَاتٍ مِنْهَا دَابَّةُ الْأَرْضِ وَ الدَّجَّالُ وَ نُزُولُ عِیسَی ابْنِ مَرْیَمَ (علیه السلام) وَ طُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا.
37.fa: إِنَّ اللهَ قادِرٌ عَلی أَنْ یُنَزِّلَ آیَةً؛ خداوند در آخر الزّمان نشانه‌ها [و معجزه‌هایی] به شما نشان می‌دهد که از جمله‌ی آن‌ها دابّهًْ الارض، دجّال، فرودآمدن عیسی‌بن‌مریم (علیه السلام) و طلوع خورشید از مغرب است.
37.en: Regarding His saying: "Allah is able to send down a sign," He will show you signs in the end times, among which are the Beast of the Earth (Dabbat al-Ard), the Dajjal, the descent of Jesus son of Mary (peace be upon him), and the rising of the sun from its place of setting.
37.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 372
37.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 204; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 52, p. 181; al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 198; al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

37.ar: وَ قالُوا لَوْ لا نُزِّلَ عَلَیْهِ آیَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ أَیْ هَلَّا أُنْزِلَ وَ لکِنَّ أَکْثَرَهُمْ لا یَعْلَمُونَ قَالَ لَا یَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ الْآیَةَ إِذَا جَاءَتْ وَ لَمْ یُؤْمِنُوا بِهَا لَهَلَکُوا.
37.fa: وَ قالُوا لَوْ لا نُزِّلَ عَلَیْهِ آیَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ، یعنی چرا نازل نمی‌شود؟! وَ لکِنَّ أَکْثَرَهُمْ لا یَعْلَمُونَ؛ نمی‌دانند که وقتی نشانه [و معجزه] بیاید و به آن ایمان نیاورند، هلاک می‌شوند.
37.en: "And they say, 'Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?'" meaning, why is it not sent down? "But most of them do not know," meaning they do not know that when a sign [or miracle] comes and they do not believe in it, they will be destroyed.
37.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 372
37.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 17, p. 204; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 203; Nur al-Thaqalayn

37.ar: وَصِیَّتُهُ (علیه السلام) لِهِشَامٍ وَ صفَتُهُ لِلْعَقْل ثُمَّ ذَمَّ الْکَثْرَةَ فَقَالَ وَ إِنْ تُطِعْ أَکْثَرَ مَنْ فِی الْأَرْضِ یُضِلُّوکَ عَنْ سَبِیلِ اللهِِ وَ قَالَ وَ لکِنَّ أَکْثَرَهُمْ لا یَعْلَمُونَ.
37.en: His (peace be upon him) testament to Hisham and his description of the intellect; then he condemned the majority, saying: "And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allah." And he said: "But most of them do not know."
37.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 4, p. 372
37.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 75, p. 296 / Tuhaf al-Uqul, p. 383 / Al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 15
